figurative_meaning_en: suffering from the scorching heat of the sun
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রীষ্মের দুপুরে মাঠে কাজ করতে গিয়ে রোদে পোড়া লাগলো।
দীর্ঘ যাত্রায় রোদে পোড়া অভিজ্ঞতা হয়েছে তার।
example_sentences_in_english: Working in the field during the summer noon made him feel burnt by the sun.
He had the experience of suffering from the sun's heat during the long journey.
note: This idiom reflects the intense tropical climate of Bengal, often used in contexts of physical labor under the sun.
